scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @cintexa/db && npm run dev -w api-server
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cintexa/db && npm run build -w api-server && npm run build -w cintexa
scripts.build:pages: npm run build -w @cintexa/db && npm run build -w cintexa
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @cintexa/db && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p functions/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w @cintexa/db && npm run test -w api-server && npm run test -w cintexa
